about_pullquote: I started this business to give Peterborough a plumber it can actually trust and rely on.
about_para_1: Cambridgeshire Plumbing and Tiling Ltd has served Peterborough and the surrounding area for over 18 years. Born out of frustration with unreliable tradespeople, we built the business on a single principle: show up on time, do the job right, and charge a fair price. Today, we've completed over 2,500 jobs and count hundreds of repeat customers and referrals.
about_para_2: We're not the cheapest, but we're the fastest and most reliable. Our emergency response time speaks for itself — most customers see us within an hour, day or night. Our team are fully trained in plumbing, heating, and tiling, and we take pride in leaving every home cleaner than we found it.
reviews_heading: What Peterborough Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Woke up to water pouring from the ceiling on a Sunday morning. Called Cambridgeshire Plumbing in desperation and they were here in 45 minutes. Fixed a burst pipe in the loft, cleared the damage, and explained everything clearly. Absolute lifesaver. Fair price too.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had them in for a full bathroom renovation. From start to finish, professional and clean. The tiling looks perfect and the plumbing is solid. They finished on time and within budget, which honestly never happens. Will definitely call them again.
reviews.author: Christine P.

reviews.text: Boiler went down in November. Their emergency team came the next morning, diagnosed a faulty valve, had a new one fitted and working by lunchtime. Kept the place tidy and gave me a 10-year parts warranty. Can't ask for better service.
reviews.author: David H.
